violated_contract: A tutorial question must complete from its own request outcome. A chat list is a filtered projection: another selected thread can hide a successful answer and unrelated traffic can appear in the list. Neither list length nor any new AI row establishes that this request succeeded.
canonical_prevention: Return the typed answer or terminal failure through the existing voice/capture pipeline to the owning tutorial attempt, preserve chat isolation, advance only on admitted capture transitions, bound the response stream, and reject stale callbacks after exit or restart.
